Explicit matrix eigenvectors, normalized stationary density, and uniform-density decomposition hold symbolically for all 0<b<1; the third-cell deviation sign is controlled by a strictly smaller subdominant mode. Mass conservation then gives the exact all-n positive-part TV formula; the limiting sign of 1-b-b² gives its sharp golden-ratio prefactor. The package checker independently confirms identities and 68 exact-rational finite-time cases; the mathematical proof, not enumeration, covers all parameters and times.

value.rationale: The originating numerical statistical-tuning study motivates controlling not just stationary means but also transient sampling bias. The curve a=0,c=b² is the natural postcritical 3-cycle condition b→1→b²→b, with a genuine repelling transient interval, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. The model-specific exact TV law gives an actionable sharp burn-in estimate, and the golden-ratio change in what region dominates the leading error is a structural parameter boundary, not a renamed general Markov theorem. It applies for the entire nontrivial continuum 0<b<1.
